image_url.title: Image Url

A JPEG or PNG within the endpoint's byte budget (2.5 MB by default) renders as sent; anything larger, and any other format, is re-encoded to fit (a JPEG stays JPEG, anything else becomes lossless PNG), scaled down only as far as needed and never below the requested resolution; where that resolution stops the shrink, it is sent as a JPEG of slightly lower quality instead.
